title: UDAN turns 10
topic: UDAN Regional Connectivity Scheme completes 10 years (launched 21 Oct 2016)
caption_ig:
UDAN turns 10! ✈️ Remember when flying felt like it was only for the rich?
On 21 October 2016 the Ministry of Civil Aviation launched UDAN, the Regional Connectivity Scheme, to make flights from small-town airports affordable.
ఉడాన్ పథకానికి పదేళ్లు! ✈️

📌 Exam fact: UDAN = Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik · Regional Connectivity Scheme · launched 21 Oct 2016 · Ministry of Civil Aviation
